profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
·         13 years of experience developing and maintaining software applications.
·         Experienced in creating software in DevSecOps environments, ensuring software meets high standards of security and passes CI/CD pipeline scans for automated deployments in a Kubernetes environment.
·         Utilized tools such as SonarQube, Twistlock, Anchor, and Linting to ensure secure and high-quality applications.
·         Worked as a full-stack engineer in Java using JSF and in JavaScript using React, Vite, and ExpressJS.
·         Experience working with C# scripts while creating WebGL software applications using Unity and accessing AWS government cloud services to load assets remotely and on demand.
·         Manager and mentor to junior and mid-level software engineers.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Hill Air Force Base, Utah, United States · On-site
positions.description: Managing a team of engineers to ensure software standards are met to pass security and reliability scans in a CI/CD pipeline. Working closely with clients to solidify requirements and proactively direct software engineering tasks in an agile environment. Leading coordinated efforts across multiple teams to properly maintain applications in a DevSecOps environment and follow a secure-by-design principal in development and delivery while mitigating vulnerabilities by updating Iron Bank image versions being used in Docker deployments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked closely with a DevSecOps team to build and deploy software in an air-gapped environment that runs Kubernetes to deploy containers. Solved problems related to ensuring software dependencies and licenses were available in an air-gapped environment as well as working around some inconsistent database connectivity issues to ensure a positive software experience for users. Created minimum viable products (MVPs) and configured gitlab yaml files to automatically deploy them for demos to potential customers. Coordinated efforts in embedded security to create encrypted secrets in a Kubernetes environment and provide them as environment variables for deployed applications.

positions.title: Application Developer II
positions.description: Collaborate with team members in the development and maintenance of a web application using Java Server Faces, Java, Oracle, Git, Unity, and C# as the main platforms for development and worked with the team to integrate tools, maintain backend databases, and handle configurations of existing applications for clients to effectively maintain productivity with their projects.

positions.title: Technical Analyst
positions.description: Used Javascript and HTML to create a questionnaire program in order to enhance quality of software support among authorized application administration specialists for existing clients.

positions.title: Reporting Specialist
positions.description: Analyzed databases to create reports using SQL in order to generate reports for clients for them to view data in a meaningful way.

positions.title: Deal Approval Specialist
positions.description: Used Visual Basic to develop and maintain a program embedded in an excel document as a macro that was used to localize research from multiple online and local resources and displayed them in a single location in a meaningful way in order to promote informed decisions on promotion approvals and to programmatically log information found in the search.

positions.title: Provider Relations - Escalated Retrieval Agent
positions.description: Created macro programs within excel using Visual Basic that asks questions and generates emails programmatically in order to collaborate more effectively between departments and efficiently handle online payments more quickly.

positions.title: Customer Account Executive
positions.description: Practiced troubleshooting skills while working with customers to troubleshoot their cable, building rapport, and maximizing customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Telecommunications Aid
positions.description: Installed category 3 and category 5 cables in commercial buildings along with the other various components that accompany these lines in order for a company to work effectively with communication while improving the company’s image.

certifications.name: Amazon Web Services DevOps Engineer - Professional
certifications.title: Amazon Web Services DevOps Engineer - Professional
